title: 第一卷 第9章 逃离第一卷 第10章 放生
lines: 林风眠在青韭峰待了三年，对这里滚瓜烂熟，轻车熟路绕过了守卫。
但也不知道是不是做贼心虚，他总感觉像是有人跟着他，却遍寻不得。
林风眠不敢耽搁，也不敢多想，在身上贴上神行符，在山间狂奔。
此刻，是玉仙宗上下最松懈的时候，充实了一天的师姐们也难得放空自己。
不过半空中，还是不时有流光飞过，那却是巡逻的弟子。
林风眠并没有往山门方向，而是目的明确地往玉仙宗的广场方向跑去。
玉仙宗四周有阵法环绕，想从周围翻山越岭逃出去，无异于痴人说梦。
至于从山门离开，不少聪明的师弟也帮林风眠趟过雷了，只有死路一条。
一旦被玉仙宗妖女逮住，那是生不如死，还要被榨干最后价值，死状难以言说。
不知道是不是为了杀鸡儆猴，她们让林风眠处理了几具尸体。
因此，林风眠对此深有体会。
他研究许久，最后得出结论：想从玉仙宗逃出去，只能由这些妖女带着！
虽然想让这些妖女心甘情愿带他出去，几乎不可能，但这难不倒林风眠。
他小心翼翼在林间潜行，不一会就来到了一处广场边上。
广场极为宽阔，上面停靠着几艘飞船，不远处有弟子正打着呵欠。
林风眠的目光落在不远处的一艘飞船上，这就是他此行的目标。
玉仙宗这么多弟子，自然是需要吃喝拉撒的，日常消耗的物资并不少。
而每隔数日，玉仙宗的内务堂便会外出采购，这就是他唯一逃出去的机会。
按林风眠所得到的消息，今天内务堂就会出门一趟。
而这个消息，也在陈清焰昨天的话语中得到了证实。
林风眠小心翼翼靠近，暗中观察许久，却始终没有找到机会靠近。
那几个看守的弟子虽然哈欠连连，但坐的位置却很刁钻，几乎毫无死角。
就在林风眠犹豫自己该怎么弄出点动静来时，远处突然传来一股诡异的灵力波动。
看守的弟子一下子被这股突如其来的灵力波动吸引，纷纷看了过去。
“怎么回事？”
“难道有人？过去看看！”
这千载难逢的机会，林风眠自然不会错过，迅速卡住身位跑了过去。
看守的弟子都是些不到金丹期的弟子，根本没有神识，只能用肉眼观看。
林风眠胆大心细，没有操之过急，并没有弄出什么动静，很快来到广场边缘。
整个广场都被阵法屏障笼罩，需要弟子令牌查验。
青韭峰的韭菜令自然是没用的，只有玉仙宗真正的弟子令牌才能通过。
林风眠迅速拿出陈清焰的弟子令，把心一横直接向屏障撞去。
一道柔和的光芒笼罩周身，他顿时把心提到了嗓子眼。
好在这种低阶令牌没有什么血脉绑定，林风眠成功穿了过去。
他欣喜若狂，迅速靠近飞船，甩出一道自制的钩锁，灵动如猿地爬了上去。
为了这一刻的轻盈矫健，林风眠在青韭峰的后山，可是苦练了一年多，摔得鼻青脸肿。
但在成功登上飞船的刹那，一切付出都是值得的！
在那些弟子回过头之时，林风眠已经趴在了甲板上，缓缓向舱门爬去。
他虽然心跳如雷，却还是极力控制着呼吸，避免被看守的弟子察觉。
那几个弟子也没想过会有人会混入飞船中，只是随意扫了一眼就没再多看。
“那边怎么回事？”
content_en:
Lin Fengmian has been at Qingjiu Peak for three years and is very familiar with the place. He can bypass the guards with ease.
But he didn't know if he was guilty of being a thief. He always felt like someone was following him, but he couldn't find him anywhere.
Lin Fengmian didn't dare to delay or think too much, so he put a magic talisman on his body and ran wildly in the mountains.
At this moment, everyone in the Jade Immortal Sect is most relaxed, and the senior sisters who have had a full day rarely let themselves go.
However, in mid-air, there were still streams of light flying by from time to time, but they were patrolling disciples.
Lin Fengmian did not go towards the mountain gate, but ran towards the Jade Immortal Sect's square with a clear purpose.
Jade Immortal Sect is surrounded by formations, and trying to escape over the surrounding mountains and ridges is tantamount to wishful thinking.
As for leaving from the mountain gate, many smart junior brothers also helped Lin Fengmian get through the thunder. There was only a dead end.
Once caught by the enchantress of the Jade Immortal Sect, life would be worse than death, and the last value would be squeezed out, and the state of death would be unspeakable.
I don't know if it was to kill chickens to scare monkeys, but they asked Lin Fengmian to dispose of several corpses.
Therefore, Lin Fengmian understands this deeply.
He studied for a long time and finally came to the conclusion: if you want to escape from the Jade Immortal Sect, you can only be led by these witches!
Although it was almost impossible to get these witches to take him out willingly, it was not difficult for Lin Fengmian.
He carefully sneaked through the forest and soon came to the edge of a square.
The square is extremely wide, with several spaceships parked on it. Not far away, a disciple is yawning.
Lin Fengmian's eyes fell on a spaceship not far away. This was the goal of his trip.
With so many disciples of the Jade Immortal Sect, they naturally need to eat, drink and defecate, and they consume a lot of supplies on a daily basis.
And every few days, the Jade Immortal Sect's Internal Affairs Hall would go out for shopping. This was his only chance to escape.
According to the news Lin Fengmian received, the Internal Affairs Department will make a trip today.
And this news was confirmed in Chen Qingyan's words yesterday.
Lin Fengmian approached cautiously, observing secretly for a long time, but never found a chance to get closer.
Although the disciples on guard yawned repeatedly, their sitting positions were very tricky, with almost no blind spots.
Just when Lin Fengmian was hesitating about how to make some noise, a strange spiritual power fluctuation suddenly came from the distance.
The disciples guarding him were suddenly attracted by this sudden fluctuation of spiritual power, and they all looked over.
"What's going on?"
"Is there anyone? Go over and have a look!"
…
Naturally, Lin Fengmian would not miss this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity and quickly ran over.
The disciples guarding it were all disciples who were not at the golden elixir stage. They had no spiritual consciousness at all and could only see with their naked eyes.
Lin Fengmian was brave and careful, did not act too hastily, and quickly reached the edge of the square without making any noise.
The entire square is shrouded in a formation barrier, requiring disciple tokens to be checked.
The Chive Order of Qingjiu Peak is naturally useless. Only the token of a true disciple of the Jade Immortal Sect can pass.
Lin Fengmian quickly took out Chen Qingyan's disciple order and smashed his heart directly towards the barrier.
A soft light enveloped his whole body, and his heart suddenly rose to his throat.
Fortunately, this low-level token was not bound by blood, so Lin Fengmian successfully passed through it.
He was ecstatic, quickly approached the spacecraft, threw out a homemade hook lock, and climbed up as agile as an ape.
In order to be light and strong at this moment, Lin Fengmian was on the back mountain of Qingjiu Peak. However, after practicing hard for more than a year, his nose was bruised and his face was swollen.
But the moment you successfully board the spacecraft, all the efforts are worth it!
When those disciples turned around, Lin Fengmian was already lying on the deck and slowly crawling towards the hatch.
Although his heart was beating like thunder, he still tried his best to control his breathing to avoid being noticed by the guarding disciples.
Those disciples never thought that anyone would sneak into the spaceship. They just glanced at it casually and didn't look any further.
"What's going on over there?"
